animationSystem: Auto-Rig Pro registered custom quadruped Action set on a single visible skinned mesh; Shape Key drivers remain for breathing and liquid deformation support

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Static_Review
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Reference standing pose for side-by-side review.

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Idle
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Body morph breathing with light chest and head sway.

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Move_LimpingBladeArm
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Four separate beast crawl leg cycles with a slower dragging blade arm.

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Attack_Slam
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Raise upper body, lift left blade arm and right foreleg, slam forward, then drag back along the floor.

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Hit_Recoil
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Head side shake with a backward body recoil.

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Consume_BiteSlam
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Head winds back, snaps forward, and pecks downward at the target.

runtimeAnimationActions.name: LongaArma_Death_Melt
runtimeAnimationActions.description: Whole body melts into a flat liquid puddle.

autoRigPro.usedFor: Action export registration and FBX/GLB export settings; Smart marker auto-rig is not used because Longa Arma is a non-humanoid asymmetric quadruped.
